description: Перелік перевізників, що надають послуги пасажирського автомобільного транспорту, та маршрутів перевезення is a dataset listed in data.gov.ua, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Бучацька міська рада. List of carriers providing transport services for the transportation of passengers by urban electric and road transport. Coverage: Бучацька міська рада. The portal shows the English title as "List of carriers providing passenger road transport services and transportation routes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Бучацька міська рада. Its keywords include перевізники, перевезення пасажирів. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-05-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua.
